envelope.description: Add an optional streaming method to IpcClient

body.title: Add an optional streaming method to IpcClient
body.summary: Add an optional stream method to the IpcClient interface and its implementation in src/shared/ipc-client.ts (open a stream request, deliver frames to a callback, return a handle that closes the socket), modelled on src/mcp/daemon-stream.ts. It is optional so the IpcClient test doubles (per-role-engine, registrar, activation and controller tests) keep compiling; only subscribing modules check for it.
acceptanceChecks: a client opens a stream, receives the frames the daemon pushes and closes it
closing the handle closes the socket and the server aborts the handler
the existing IpcClient test doubles compile unchanged

tests.name: src/shared/__tests__/ipc-client-stream.test.ts: a client opens a stream, receives the pushed frames and closes it
src/shared/__tests__/ipc-client-stream.test.ts: closing the handle aborts the server's stream handler
